name: Imagify
summary: Image compression and WebP and AVIF conversion for WordPress, through a plugin that also bulk-optimises an existing media library; plans are metered by megabytes of images a month.
best_for: WordPress site owners with image-heavy pages, such as blogs, stores and portfolios, who want images compressed and converted to WebP or AVIF by a plugin instead of by hand
skip_if: your site is not on WordPress; your host, CDN or theme already compresses and converts images; or you add only a few images a month and the free quota or a manual tool covers it
honest_knock: A prepaid yearly plan is not refunded. The free tier's 20MB a month and 2MB per image are only enough for a test, Growth charges $5 for each extra GB, and Infinite's unlimited use falls under a fair-use clause.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Growth · per month, billed yearly, excluding tax
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-17 in a browser on imagify.io/pricing in the yearly view, with the monthly rates read on the same page on 15 October 2026; the terms name US dollars, excluding tax) Starter is $0 a month: 20MB a month, about 200 images, unlimited websites, 2MB maximum per image, no credit card. Growth is $4.99 a month billed yearly, or $5.99 billed monthly: 500MB a month, about 5,000 images, unlimited websites and upload size, and $5 for each additional GB. Infinite is $9.99 a month billed yearly, or $11.99 monthly: unlimited images, websites and upload size at no extra cost, subject to the fair-use clause in the terms. The page advertises two months free on yearly billing but does not show the yearly invoice total. The terms rule out a refund on a prepaid twelve-month subscription. You cancel from the Billing page, and images already optimised stay optimised.

free_plan_evidence: (read 2026-10-17 in a browser on imagify.io/pricing in the yearly view, with the monthly rates read on the same page on 15 October 2026; the terms name US dollars, excluding tax) Starter is $0 a month: 20MB a month, about 200 images, unlimited websites, 2MB maximum per image, no credit card.

compare_with.name: WP Rocket
compare_with.why: WP Rocket is in our dossiers too and comes from the same group of WordPress companies, but it is a caching plugin, priced as annual licences from $59 a year for one site when we read it on 2 October 2026. Imagify does the image side: compression and next-gen formats. Many sites run both.
